scenarios.name: prowess-pumps-until-end-of-turn
scenarios.why: Prowess: casting the noncreature Lightning Bolt makes Grim Repriser 3/3 until end of turn; by the opponent's next upkeep it is 2/2 again.

scenarios.name: not-offered-without-opponent-noncombat-damage
scenarios.why: 'Activate only if an opponent has been dealt noncombat damage this turn': with {B}{R} floating it is not offered at the start of the turn, nor after its controller Bolts THEMSELVES (not an opponent), nor after the opponent takes only COMBAT damage from Savannah Lions (2/1, so 20 -> 18).

scenarios.name: returns-with-finality-counter
scenarios.why: After Lightning Bolt deals 3 noncombat damage to the opponent, {B}{R} returns Grim Repriser from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it, a 2/2.

scenarios.name: finality-counter-exiles-it-when-it-would-die
scenarios.why: Returned with a finality counter, it is then dealt lethal damage: a second Lightning Bolt targeting it (prowess makes it 3/3, still lethal at 3 damage). With a finality counter, instead of dying it is exiled.
